subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` as a public native `sessions_spawn` and `agents.*.subagents` contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix creates durable tool/config semantics in compatibility-sensitive agent routing, which requires maintainer product intent rather than automatic issue repair.

options.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
options.body: Review and land the linked PR or equivalent after it preserves current `channel` defaults and proves parent-session routing in real behavior.

options.title: Per-spawn only first
options.body: Accept only the model-facing per-call option and defer global/per-agent defaults until operator and upgrade semantics are reviewed separately.

options.title: Keep workaround-only behavior
options.body: Pause or reject the contract and leave parent handoff to explicit `sessions_send` or channel-specific workaround patterns for now.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR or equivalent after it preserves current `channel` defaults and proves parent-session routing in real behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the tool, has recent announce-delivery history, and already supplied the focused implementation shape in the issue discussion.
